advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Add a test that _parse_paginated_comments / get_comments returns [] for empty and whitespace-only ACLI stdout (the zero-comment issue path).
evidence: Source under test handles empty input at acli_cli_ops.py:534-539: `idx, length = 0, len(stdout)` / `while idx < length:` / `if idx >= length: break`
The only fixture stdout is `_MULTIPAGE` (three non-empty pages) — tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/state/test_comment_pagination.py:48-54; no test passes empty or whitespace-only stdout
ABSENCE: no assertion that get_comments returns [] for a zero-comment issue; the pre-fix `json.loads('')` would have raised, so this is behavior the diff changes and leaves unpinned
Docstring claims safety for both shapes: acli_cli_ops.py:528-530 'A single-object or bare-list payload (the non-paginated shape) is handled as a one-iteration case, so this is a safe superset'
Fixture uses only the wrapped-dict page shape via `_page(...)` — test file lines 30-54; no bare-list stdout is decoded
ABSENCE: no test feeds a single bare-list JSON document (e.g. '[{"id":"1"}]') to _parse_paginated_comments
advisory.finding: The new _parse_paginated_comments has explicit empty/whitespace-only-stdout handling (outer `while idx < length`, whitespace-skip loop, `if idx >= length: break`) that is untested; a comment-less Jira issue (routine input under --paginate) is never exercised, so a regression making empty/whitespace stdout raise instead of returning [] would go undetected.
merged_from: The parser's documented 'safe superset' contract for the non-paginated shapes (a single wrapped-dict object and a bare JSON list) is asserted only implicitly via the multipage wrapped-dict fixture; the bare-list branch of _parse_acli_comments reached through _parse_paginated_comments is never exercised.
scenarios: A Jira issue with zero comments: ACLI emits empty or whitespace-only stdout under --paginate
A regression that calls decoder.raw_decode on empty stdout (raising JSONDecodeError) would crash comment sync for every comment-less issue
advisory.suggested_fix: Add: `def test_empty_stdout_returns_no_comments(capture): monkeypatch _run_acli to return stdout='' (and separately '   \n  '); assert acli_cli_ops.get_comments('REB-1') == [] and _make_client().get_comments('REB-1') == []`.
